A clear notice about staff rotas
It is for families
Travelers should read this notice before checking in any companion animal. The Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways is updating staff rotas so that handovers stay orderly and service remains steady.

Please allow for varied point of contact during booking, drop-off, and collection. The ground team continues to move carriers with care between services, and prompt, respectful communication helps us protect both pets and schedules. <<FACT F072>> If your travel plan includes a bird, please note <<FACT F059>> so the booking record stays accurate.

For rabbit travel, the pet and crate must remain within the required limit. <<FACT F064>> Follow the packing advice given at the desk, and bring any papers asked for at check-in. Keep water, ventilation, and handling instructions ready, since the team may need to confirm them before acceptance.

If you are traveling with several animals, please speak with the desk in advance. This helps the staff review each case properly and reduce avoidable delays. The desk will guide you through the steps from booking through pickup, and will raise any concern without delay.

For support, visit the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
